steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism – the arms race and glorification of military power among European powers  
2. System of Alliances – binding treaties (Triple Entente vs. Triple Alliance) that drew many nations in once conflict began  
3. Imperialism – competition for colonies and global influence heightened rivalries between major powers
